dedupe_keys.name: geothermal project on tu delft campus del gt 01 and del gt 02 wireline logs

description: TU Delft publishes open-hole wireline measurements acquired during installation of its campus geothermal doublet. The producer DEL-GT-01 and injector DEL-GT-02 reservoir sections were logged between June and November 2023. The release describes gamma-ray, density, porosity, resistivity, borehole imaging, sonic and nuclear magnetic resonance measurements. Composite logs are described as PDF, with measurement logs in LAS well-log and DLIS instrument formats. Coverage: Coverage is the campus geothermal site in Delft, Netherlands. Composite display scales include 1:200 and 1:1000; measurement sampling resolution is not established. Access: the public 4TU.ResearchData record describes the release. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and current file access are unverified. Caveats: An older description specifies an embargo through 31 December 2025. Current metadata reports no active embargo; file retrieval was not tested. LAS denotes well logs, not point-cloud geometry. Simulation uses include geothermal reservoir characterisation and calibration. Related resources are listed in the same native collection; distinct release identities are preserved.
